question: Which shipments have a specific status?Answer

candidates.query: SELECT ?s WHERE { ?p a :Product . ?i a :Inventory . ?s a :Shipment . ?o a :Order . ?o :order_id ?o_order_id . ?p :STOCKS ?i . ?o :DEPENDS_ON ?s . FILTER(?o_order_id = 'placeholder_order_id') }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?t a :Tool . ?p a :Product . ?ls a :ProcessStep . ?m a :Material . ?l :PROCESSED_WITH ?t . ?p :REQUIRES ?ls . ?ls :USED_IN ?m . }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?c a :CapacityConstraint . ?f a :Fab . ?p a :Product . ?ps a :ProcessStep . ?m a :Material . ?f :PRODUCES ?p . ?p :REQUIRES ?ps . ?ps :USED_IN ?m . }
